status_definitions.verified: The recorded target has reproducible repository or command evidence.
status_definitions.partially_verified: Some representative evidence exists, but the stated metric or coverage is incomplete.
status_definitions.not_baselined: No versioned corpus or repeatable measurement exists; no value may be claimed.

checks.metric: Tracked project documentation reflects current implementation and boundaries
checks.target: All tracked project documentation uses implemented, conditional, or not implemented status
checks.current: Product, architecture, handoff, module and acceptance documents reviewed against module diagnostics, built-in Skills, bounded project graphs, migration head and actual verification scope on 2026-09-10
checks.limitations: This is a documentation review, not a full scanner acceptance run. Fixture README files describe test targets. Historical command counts retain their source commits and do not imply a rerun.

checks.metric: Backend registry, frontend fallback, and project report boundaries use calibrated claims
checks.target: No current claim of industry knowledge base, full system behavior monitoring, or cross-project ASPM
checks.current: Capability-claim, declarative Skill, automatic-trigger and bounded graph tests passed within the 414-test full backend run on 2026-09-09
checks.limitations: Copy review cannot replace functional acceptance of the underlying scanners.

checks.target: All runnable tests pass with the Agent staging directory on D:
evidence: From apps/api with an existing D: temp directory: ..\..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -m pytest tests -q -rs -p no:cacheprovider
checks.limitations: One symlink test was skipped because the current Windows account cannot create symlinks. The suite emitted 32 datetime.utcnow and 2 FastAPI on_event deprecation warnings. The 307 and 317 counts are retained only as historical documentation records.

checks.target: npm run build, the development-server configuration smoke, IPv4 HTTP smoke and all eleven documented browser smoke suites exit successfully
checks.limitations: Vite reports a chunk-size warning. Authentication failure injection covers status 503, identity 503, unreachable API, timeout, retry and dual viewports. One unresolved failure remains: test:agent-ui requires a five-step runtime plan while the configured testproject has no AGENT scan task; the project owner has temporarily excluded it from the current implementation priority, but it is not rewritten as passed; follow deferred-work UI-011.

checks.metric: Project intelligence, model, target, and scan-task states are evidence-based
checks.target: Each execution module distinguishes success, partial, stale, failed, missing, unavailable, and not-applicable evidence without rewriting scanner state
checks.current: The project endpoint and detection UI report SCA intelligence freshness, saved model-call evidence, target state, and derived task completeness for SCA/SAST/AGENT/DAST/SANDBOX. The exact testproject was verified read-only on 2026-09-10.
checks.limitations: The endpoint does not actively contact arbitrary targets or invoke paid models. Configured-without-success-evidence remains unverified, stale evidence remains stale, and a successful task is not evidence that no vulnerability exists.

checks.metric: Authentication bootstrap and platform dependencies expose truthful failure states
checks.target: Authentication distinguishes logged-out, service failure, database failure, unreachable API and timeout; health checks do not claim scan success
checks.current: Only /auth/me HTTP 401 is treated as logged out. Structured health reports required and optional dependency state; required failure returns HTTP 503, optional failure is degraded.
checks.limitations: The aggregate endpoint checks API, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker and prepared local scanner tools. External-network reachability, intelligence freshness, model service, target health and scan-task execution remain module-specific and are not inferred from tool readiness.

checks.metric: Alembic schema is at repository head
checks.target: Current database revision equals the repository migration head
checks.limitations: The 0019 to 0018 to 0019 graph-table migration path was verified only on the local development database. Downgrade intentionally removes graph snapshots; it does not establish backup or production upgrade readiness.

checks.metric: A previously unseen project can be safely imported, inventoried, readiness-checked, and scanned in bounded quick mode
checks.target: Local directory, guarded ZIP, and HTTP(S) Git inputs produce project-scoped readiness and bounded static scan results
checks.current: Historical local and ZIP API checks and manifest/quick-limit regression tests exist; 2026-09-08 verified only the configured testproject path, source commit and stored database records
checks.limitations: Cold-start import and target scans were not rerun in this documentation maintenance. Private Git access depends on host credentials; dynamic validation requires an authorized runtime target. Stored scan status is not a fresh execution result.

checks.metric: Precision, false-positive rate, and recall for SCA/SAST/AGENT
checks.target: Versioned labeled positive and negative corpus with per-module thresholds
checks.limitations: Functional fixtures and live project findings are not a labeled effectiveness benchmark.

checks.metric: Repeated DAST verdict agreement and evidence completeness
checks.target: Versioned replay corpus with repeated-run agreement and evidence-completeness thresholds
checks.limitations: Existing validations prove workflow execution, not a general reproducibility rate.

checks.metric: Manifest parsing and scan completion across documented ecosystems
checks.target: Pinned fixture matrix for every documented ecosystem, language, package manager, and supported version
checks.current: Parsers and representative tests exist; a versioned compatibility matrix does not
checks.limitations: Documented parser support is not a certified success rate for arbitrary projects.

checks.metric: Sandbox policy enforcement and escape resistance
checks.target: Versioned negative corpus covering network, filesystem, process, capability, resource, secret, and escape boundaries
checks.current: Policy tests and deterministic safe/MCP fixtures passed in the 2026-09-08 full backend run; the complete isolation matrix and independent escape assessment remain absent
checks.limitations: The platform is not eBPF/Sysmon/EDR and has no independent container escape assessment.

checks.metric: Production deployment, IAM, tenant isolation, evidence protection, backup, and recovery
checks.target: Threat-modeled production architecture and tested operational controls
checks.limitations: The current release is explicitly limited to a controlled single-host development environment.
